metrics.name: 7日留存率
metrics.desc: 注册日为 cohort，注册后第 1~7 天内出现过 app_open 记为留存；分母=该 cohort 新客数，仅统计观察窗已满 7 天的 cohort（口径写死在 ads_retention 视图）。注意：不是「近 7 天活跃」，是「注册后 7 日回访」。
metrics.sql:
SELECT SUM(new_users) AS new_users,
                      SUM(retained_7d) AS retained_7d,
                      ROUND(1.0*SUM(retained_7d)/NULLIF(SUM(new_users),0),4) AS retention_7d_rate
               FROM ads_retention
               WHERE cohort_dt BETWEEN :start AND :end
                 AND (:region='ALL' OR region=:region)

metrics.name: 次日留存率
metrics.desc: 注册后第 1 天（D+1）出现 app_open 记为留存；分母=该 cohort 新客数。
metrics.sql:
SELECT SUM(new_users) AS new_users,
                      SUM(retained_1d) AS retained_1d,
                      ROUND(1.0*SUM(retained_1d)/NULLIF(SUM(new_users),0),4) AS retention_1d_rate
               FROM ads_retention
               WHERE cohort_dt BETWEEN :start AND :end
                 AND (:region='ALL' OR region=:region)

metrics.name: 复购率
metrics.desc: 全周期口径（不按时间窗切分）：下单天数>=2 的付费用户 / 全部付费用户；按用户去重，非按订单数。
metrics.sql:
SELECT SUM(repurchase_users) AS repurchase_users,
                      SUM(total_users) AS total_users,
                      ROUND(1.0*SUM(repurchase_users)/NULLIF(SUM(total_users),0),4) AS repurchase_rate
               FROM ads_repurchase
               WHERE :region='ALL' OR region=:region

metrics.name: 下单转化率
metrics.desc: checkout_uv / view_uv，同一自然日同一区域内去重用户数之比；口径为浏览→下单，非点击→支付。
metrics.sql:
SELECT dt, region,
                      ROUND(1.0*SUM(checkout_uv)/NULLIF(SUM(view_uv),0),4) AS order_cvr
               FROM ads_daily_region
               WHERE dt BETWEEN :start AND :end
                 AND (:region='ALL' OR region=:region)
               GROUP BY dt, region ORDER BY dt LIMIT 200

metrics.name: 支付转化率
metrics.desc: pay_uv / checkout_uv，下单→支付的去重用户转化；与 GMV 无直接换算关系。
metrics.sql:
SELECT dt, region,
                      ROUND(1.0*SUM(pay_uv)/NULLIF(SUM(checkout_uv),0),4) AS pay_cvr
               FROM ads_daily_region
               WHERE dt BETWEEN :start AND :end
                 AND (:region='ALL' OR region=:region)
               GROUP BY dt, region ORDER BY dt LIMIT 200

metrics.name: 客单价
metrics.desc: GMV / 已支付订单数，非「GMV / 付费用户数」；金额为元，四舍五入 2 位。
metrics.sql:
SELECT dt, region,
                      ROUND(1.0*SUM(gmv)/NULLIF(SUM(paid_orders),0),2) AS aov
               FROM ads_daily_region
               WHERE dt BETWEEN :start AND :end
                 AND (:region='ALL' OR region=:region)
               GROUP BY dt, region ORDER BY dt LIMIT 200

metrics.name: 成交总额(GMV)
metrics.desc: 仅 status='paid' 的订单金额求和；不含退款订单，不含未支付订单。
metrics.sql:
SELECT dt, region, SUM(gmv) AS gmv
               FROM ads_daily_region
               WHERE dt BETWEEN :start AND :end
                 AND (:region='ALL' OR region=:region)
               GROUP BY dt, region ORDER BY dt LIMIT 200

metrics.name: 新增用户数
metrics.desc: 按注册日(register_date)计，非首单日；按 user_id 去重，一个用户只计一次。
metrics.sql:
SELECT dt, region, SUM(new_users) AS new_users
               FROM ads_daily_region
               WHERE dt BETWEEN :start AND :end
                 AND (:region='ALL' OR region=:region)
               GROUP BY dt, region ORDER BY dt LIMIT 200

metrics.name: 日活跃用户数(DAU)
metrics.desc: 当日出现 app_open 事件的去重用户数；不含仅浏览/下单未打开 App 的用户。
metrics.sql:
SELECT dt, region, SUM(dau) AS dau
               FROM ads_daily_region
               WHERE dt BETWEEN :start AND :end
                 AND (:region='ALL' OR region=:region)
               GROUP BY dt, region ORDER BY dt LIMIT 200

metrics.name: 月活跃用户数(MAU)
metrics.desc: 截至 end 日往前 30 天窗口内出现任意事件的去重用户数；窗口为滚动 30 天，非自然月。
metrics.sql:
SELECT :region AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS mau
               FROM dwd_event
               WHERE dt BETWEEN date(:end,'-29 day') AND :end
                 AND (:region='ALL' OR region=:region)
